sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 9B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model has a default context length of 262,144 tokens. If you encounter out-of-memory (OOM) errors, consider reducing the context window. However, because Qwen3.5 leverages extended context for complex tasks, we advise maintaining a context length of at least 128K tokens to preserve thinking capabilities.

sources.title: How is Abliterated different from the normal Qwen3.5-9B?
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5-9B Abliterated is a community-modified build of Alibaba's 9B multimodal model that strips safety refusals while keeping core reasoning intact. Run it locally on Mac, Windows, or Linux via Ollama, GGUF in llama.cpp, MLX, or vLLM.
